title: Duplicate in a Set
instructions: What happens when you add a duplicate element to a mutable set using `.add()`?

options.text: The program crashes with an error
The duplicate is added, making two copies
It is ignored and the size stays the same

explanation: Sets only keep unique elements. When you try to add an element that is already in the set, the `.add()` call is ignored and the set stays the same. The `.add()` method returns `false` to let you know nothing was added.
